limitations: Not a quiet host; no FPS guarantee or causal confidence interval. Independent processes run indexed then origin control; no randomized paired timing.
Unknown first visits retain canonical origin work. Cold batch includes repeated known points; first cold request is separately recorded.
Logical metadata excludes BTree/FIFO allocator overhead/native codec/returned frames. Whole-process memory is observational, not bounded by this count.
Sparse certificate capture requires at least 128 native frames decoded inside that canonical request. Ordinary short sequential work does not hash native planes.
Only Unix identity fence supports indexing; other OS keep origin policy and were not measured.
No-preroll prototype rejected every negative-origin candidate and fell back exactly. All-request prototype adds ~22ms per 4K frame and was rejected.
Only 60s 320x180 long scrub and 2s 4K HEVC forward measured here. DSP/VT/GPU region/lifetime remain separate required work.
